text:
alex_t: Final runway check — marketplace launch with CloudStore + TitanHW + IntegrateCo. Need final signoffs for press/blog/landing + partner asset handoffs. Timeline today: embargo lift Fri 11:00 PT (adjusted). Who's blocking?

maria_g: I'm on press draft, legal still needs to confirm partner quotes (waiting on IntegrateCo legal). ETA EOD Thursday.

sanjay_r: Connected with IntegrateCo legal, they're OK with quote language but need logo guidelines from design. @emily_ops do we have final logos?

emily_ops: sending logos now to #design review. Expect assets in 30m. Also: we still need performance numbers verified for the landing page (latency/cost blurbs). @ben_marketing can you confirm?

ben_marketing: yep I'll re-run the 99th p latency snapshot today and publish to the PR content. Will upload to shared drive + add UTM tags. Also want to confirm co-author on blog: CloudStore engineer + Redwood PM?

alex_t: yep co-author OK. Also checklist: 
```
- Press embargo note signed by partners
- Legal partner quote signoff
- Final logos (SVG + PNG) on CDN
- Landing page hero copy + performance stats
- Blog draft + co-author approvals
- Social cadence + tracking links
- Press list and embargo distribution file
- Promo assets (twitter cards, email banner)
- Integration guide quickstart (1-pager)
```

maria_g: quick note — pressbot scheduled embargo tool shows conflicts with IntegrateCo's external event on Friday afternoon. Suggest moving public lift to Fri 11:00 PT so partners can align.

sanjay_r: +1 for 11:00. IntegrateCo ops also requested a short dry-run of the landing page links at 09:30 PT to validate redirects.

emily_ops: dry-run OK, I'll spin up a temporary staging route and share creds in a thread here.

pressbot: Embargo scheduled: 2026-03-27T11:00:00-07:00 (Fri) by @maria_g — reminders: 48h, 2h, 15m. See https://press.redwood.ai/embargo/1789994321

ben_marketing: Action items assigned: 
- ben_marketing: publish performance snapshot and UTMs
- emily_ops: upload logos + staging route
- maria_g: finalize press release and embargo file
- sanjay_r: confirm IntegrateCo legal signoff
- alex_t: coordinate dry-run and distribution list

maria_g: I'm adding editors for the blog: @ben_marketing, @alex_t, @cloudstore_pm (invited). Anyone else?

alex_t: add @support_lead for post-launch ops FAQ.

sanjay_r: legal just pinged — minor trademark wording change, will approve once marketing updates one sentence.

ben_marketing: I'll update copy in 10m and ping legal. Also creating the email banner (will attach here).

emily_ops: logos uploaded: /drive/partners/titanhw/logos/v2 + /drive/partners/cloudstore/logos/final. Staging route: https://staging.redwood.ai/partners/marketplace-test — creds in DM.

maria_g: thanks. last blocker: do we have an exec quote for press? @ceo is OOO but gave a short line to use: "This collaboration brings predictable inference at scale to more customers." Can we confirm we can use it?

alex_t: yes approved for press.

ben_marketing: ok prepping final asset zip. Plan: dry-run 09:30 PT, partner signoff by 10:30 PT, embargo lift 11:00 PT.

sanjay_r: LGTM. Anything else?

emily_ops: please remind partners to set CORS for CDN assets before dry-run.

maria_g: noted. I'll send the distribution list and embargo reminders now. :rocket:
